items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: That's the reason I wouldn't be bothered with my little boy.

ctx.x: Henry Dog. Henry Dog. By the way, we were talking last time about the changes in drumming. Have there been many changes in drumming that you can describe how it happened? The changes in how? Well, I mean, in late years, the way they play drums now with these modern bands is different. And I wouldn't play drums.

I wouldn't play drums. Because the book will tell you that the best drum is your foundation. It's like this . It's like this . Honestly, you couldn't build this . It's like this . foundation. And the bass drum is a foundation of any band. And you gotta keep that bass drum going at all times. That hold that band together, you know. But the color playing drums now they hit. Open spaces and all that. And they'd be behind time sometimes, they'd be on time, on the side of time. And most of the drummers, they don't…
